knowledge_learned: Write an integer as a sum of digit times place value. Reducing each term modulo the divisor preserves the remainder of the sum.
If d divides 10 to the power k, changing the prefix before the last k digits cannot change the remainder modulo d.
The smallest sufficient ending widths for 4, 8, 16 and 125 are two, three, four and three digits respectively.
For a specific ending, fewer digits can sometimes rule out divisibility. An odd final digit rules out a multiple of 4 or 8.
